records.title: Evaluating cross-dataset transfer learning for photoplethysmography-based blood pressure estimation
records.model_method: Compact BP-CRNN pretrained on a source dataset; last convolutional and fully connected layers are fine-tuned with limited target-subject data.
records.main_results: Cross-dataset personalization on 200 patients achieved SBP/DBP MAE 3.36/1.81 mmHg, about 13% better than no transfer; external wearable-domain errors remained around SBP 10.5–10.9 and DBP 6.9 mmHg in the prior review.

calibration.notes: Needs limited target-user PPG with reference BP.

subject_split.notes: Evaluation is organized by target subjects; source and target datasets are distinct.

deployment.notes: Personal reference BP is required before deployment, not for each prediction.

leakage_audit.abp_bp_denormalization: not reported as current-test target dependent
leakage_audit.abp_bp_alignment: dataset synchronization used; no per-window target alignment confirmed
leakage_audit.abp_bp_windowing: reference BP used to create supervised target windows
leakage_audit.abp_bp_quality_filtering: quality filtering present; exact target dependence needs protocol audit
leakage_audit.target_dependent_calibration: historical target-subject BP used for fine-tuning
leakage_audit.window_leakage: controlled by subject-specific protocol but temporal proximity remains a concern
leakage_audit.subject_leakage: not the primary risk; evaluation is personalized by design
leakage_audit.notes: Strong deployment relevance, but personalized results cannot be read as calibration-free cross-person generalization.

records.notes: 重点深审。

records.title: Few-Shot Personalized Blood Pressure Estimation from Photoplethysmography and Physiological Priors via Low-Rank Adaptation

source.venue: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics

records.model_method: Population-pretrained Transformer personalized with sampling-rate-robust LoRA (SRR-LoRA) and pulse-pressure consistency loss.
records.main_results: Reported SBP MAE 1.52 mmHg and DBP MAE 1.07 mmHg after few-shot personalization; 2,405 pretraining subjects and 316 personalization subjects were described in the prior daily review.

calibration.notes: Requires labeled personal PPG/BP examples; exact shot count varies by experiment and is not safely reduced here to a single number.

subject_split.notes: Personalization cohorts are subject-based; exact train/validation/test protocol still needs full-text table verification.

external_validation.notes: Multiple datasets used, but no clearly independent external clinical validation was confirmed.

deployment.notes: Deployment can be PPG-only after onboarding, but cuff/reference BP is needed to create the personalized adapter.

leakage_audit.target_dependent_calibration: historical personal BP labels used for onboarding
leakage_audit.subject_leakage: lower risk if reported subject protocol is followed
leakage_audit.notes: No evidence that current test BP is needed at inference; personalization can still make same-person evaluation optimistic if calibration/test windows are too close.

records.notes: 重点深审；不要把“少样本个体化”误写成“无需校准”。

records.title: Feasibility and performance evaluation of PPG on a Galaxy Watch in continuous central blood pressure monitoring
records.model_method: PPG algorithm detects relative MAP/SBP/DBP changes against invasive central aortic BP; prospective catheterization evaluation.
records.main_results: For ≥15% MAP increase AUC 0.85; MAP-change correlation r=0.92 with bias 0.51 mmHg; median detection delay 1 min; uncalibrated change detection remained robust.

calibration.type: baseline calibration optional for change tracking
calibration.notes: Calibrated and uncalibrated relative-change analyses were both reported.

subject_split.notes: Development and prospective evaluation cohorts are separate.

external_validation.notes: Reference is invasive central aortic BP.

deployment.judgment: 适合 ΔBP/MAP 变化检测，非绝对 BP 产品验证
deployment.notes: Protocol did not satisfy all relevant validation requirements.

leakage_audit.abp_bp_alignment: minute-level paired reference used for evaluation
leakage_audit.notes: Reference BP defines outcomes but is not needed by deployed PPG model.

records.notes: 重点深审。

records.title: Validation and Subgroup Analysis of the Accuracy of the Photoplethysmography-based Microlife Cuffless Upper-arm Wearable Blood Pressure Monitor
records.model_method: Commercial upper-arm PPG cuffless monitor evaluated with sequential same-arm measurements under AAMI/ESH/ISO 81060-2:2018/Amd 1:2020.
records.main_results: 120 adults; met AAMI/ESH/ISO accuracy criteria and showed broadly consistent results across age and Fitzpatrick skin-tone groups.

calibration.notes: Calibrated against a clinically validated mercury sphygmomanometer.

subject_split.notes: Prospective measurement validation rather than model train/test split.

external_validation.notes: General adult population with subgroup analysis.

deployment.judgment: 临床验证较强但需要袖带校准
deployment.notes: Suitable for frequent home measurements after calibration.

leakage_audit.subject_leakage: not applicable to prospective device validation
leakage_audit.notes: Calibration is an authorized deployment input, not leakage, provided later reference readings are only evaluation targets.

records.notes: 重点深审。

records.title: Benchmarking and Enhancing PPG-Based Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation Methods
records.model_method: Standardized 101,453-segment benchmark from 1,103 healthy adults; compares multiple models and demographic fusion.
records.main_results: No baseline model met AAMI/ISO numerical limits; demographic-enhanced MInception reduced error 23% to SBP/DBP MAE 4.75/2.90 mmHg.

calibration.notes: Demographics are covariates, not cuff calibration.

subject_split.notes: Full split manifest should be preserved in reuse.

external_validation.notes: Derived from two public ICU/OR datasets, not consumer-device clinical validation.

deployment.judgment: 有助于公平比较，非产品验证
deployment.notes: Numerical standard thresholds alone do not establish protocol compliance.

leakage_audit.abp_bp_quality_filtering: curation likely uses signal/physiological constraints; audit manifest needed
leakage_audit.window_leakage: controlled by standardized protocol; verify implementation
leakage_audit.notes: Healthy-adult subset and demographic baselines may narrow target variance.

records.notes: 重点深审。

records.title: AnyPPG: An ECG-Guided PPG Foundation Model Trained on Over 100,000 Hours of Recordings for Holistic Health Profiling
records.model_method: Dual-modal alignment places synchronized PPG and ECG representations in a shared physiological space; downstream use can retain only the PPG encoder.
records.main_results: Pretraining covers about 109,909 h from 58,796 subjects; reports average gains of 12.8% in regression and 9.1% in classification across 11 tasks.

calibration.notes: No cuff BP calibration protocol is established by the foundation-model paper.

subject_split.notes: Exact per-task split must be checked before BP claims.

external_validation.notes: Broad health tasks, not a dedicated cuffless BP device validation.

deployment.notes: ECG is privileged training supervision, not required at inference.

leakage_audit.risk_level: low for target leakage / medium for downstream split provenance
leakage_audit.abp_bp_alignment: ECG–PPG synchronization is a training signal, not BP target leakage
leakage_audit.abp_bp_windowing: not applicable to absolute BP output
leakage_audit.notes: Do not treat hypertension classification or foundation-model gains as absolute SBP/DBP validation.

records.notes: 重点深审。

records.title: Arterial blood pressure waveform reconstruction estimation from PPG using TCN–BiLSTM
records.model_method: 8 s PPG windows (2 s stride) are mapped to normalized ABP waveforms by a TCN–BiLSTM with extrema-aware Huber loss.
records.main_results: VitalDB reported SBP MAE/RMSE 3.61/5.24 and DBP 1.79/2.37 mmHg; external MIMIC-IV table reported about 4.6/1.9 mmHg MAE.

calibration.notes: However, each test ABP window supplies its own mean and standard deviation for denormalization, which functions as unavailable target information.

subject_split.notes: VitalDB split 1,568/328/330 subjects; overlapping windows stay within subject partitions.

external_validation.notes: External test without retraining is reported, but the same target-dependent preprocessing issue applies.

deployment.judgment: 按论文流程不可部署为 PPG-only 绝对 BP
inference_inputs: current true ABP window standard deviation
deployment.notes: Real deployment cannot know current ABP μ/σ needed to restore mmHg.

leakage_audit.abp_bp_denormalization: YES — per-window true ABP μ/σ stored and used for denormalization
leakage_audit.abp_bp_alignment: not explicitly reported; synchronization source is pre-extracted paired data
leakage_audit.abp_bp_windowing: YES — ABP peaks/troughs define labels and validity; minimum three ABP peaks required
leakage_audit.abp_bp_quality_filtering: YES — true SBP/DBP/PP ranges and ABP peak count filter windows
leakage_audit.target_dependent_calibration: YES in effect through per-window ABP denormalization
leakage_audit.window_leakage: overlapping windows, but subject-wise partitions prevent cross-subject-window overlap
leakage_audit.subject_leakage: NO according to reported subject-wise split
leakage_audit.notes: Subject split and external data do not cancel leakage caused by current-test ABP statistics and ABP-based test selection.

records.notes: 本库最高优先级泄露案例。
inference_inputs: current true ABP window standard deviation

records.title: Cuffless hemodynamic monitoring with physics-informed machine learning models
records.model_method: BioZ signal encoder plus signal-tagged PINN constrained by Navier–Stokes/elastic-tube physics predicts BP and radial/axial velocity fields.
records.main_results: Cross-sectional r² ranges about 0.588–0.854 across cohorts; subject-specific models reached higher r². One-year pilot required daily recalibration to maintain performance.

calibration.type: population model plus optional subject-specific/daily recalibration
calibration.notes: Despite calibration-free framing, full text reports limited longitudinal generalization and daily recalibration in the pilot.

subject_split.notes: Population-wide results are shown without test-exclusive patients; subject-specific results are not unseen-subject generalization.

external_validation.dataset_or_cohort: healthy, hypertension, CVD and ICU/outpatient cohorts
external_validation.notes: No established cuffless BP validation protocol yet.

deployment.judgment: 硬件可穿戴，算法纵向稳定性不足
deployment.current_reference_bp_required: not for each estimate; daily reference may be needed longitudinally
deployment.notes: Watch battery about 6 h under continuous BLE in reported configuration.

leakage_audit.abp_bp_denormalization: not identified as current-window inverse scaling
leakage_audit.abp_bp_alignment: paired BP used to train adaptive filter
leakage_audit.target_dependent_calibration: daily reference recalibration in longitudinal pilot
leakage_audit.subject_leakage: population results not test-exclusive; subject-specific models are personalized
leakage_audit.notes: Not necessarily classic target leakage, but evidence does not establish calibration-free unseen-user longitudinal deployment.

records.notes: 重点深审。

records.title: Long-term accuracy and stability of blood pressure measurements from a smartwatch: Prospective validation study
records.model_method: Day-0 calibration followed by 27 days of paired Galaxy Watch 5 and Omron M4 measurements.
records.main_results: Overall MD about −0.34 mmHg SBP and +0.62 mmHg DBP; estimated 28-day drift −0.19/+1.02 mmHg. Error increased when actual BP moved about 10 mmHg away from the initial calibration point.

calibration.type: single onboarding cuff calibration per manufacturer workflow
calibration.notes: Prospective longitudinal evaluation of calibration stability.

subject_split.notes: Device validation cohort, not a retrained ML split.

external_validation.notes: Small, mostly young/normotensive cohort limits generalizability.

deployment.judgment: 真实 28 天可用证据，但人群有限
deployment.notes: Daily Omron values were reference only and did not update watch outputs.

leakage_audit.notes: Validates stability, not universal accuracy across hypertensive BP ranges.

records.notes: 重点深审。

records.title: CardioState-JEPA: Delay-Aware Cross-Modal Learning of a Shared Cardiac Representation
datasets: multiple unimodal and paired cardiac datasets
records.model_method: Two-stage joint-embedding predictive architecture with modality tokenizers, shared Transformer, masked latent prediction, and learned cross-modal delay alignment.
records.main_results: Frozen encoder reports +8.2 AUROC points for PPG classification, +18.8 for PCG murmur detection and +15.5 for ECG classification over the best SSL baseline.

calibration.notes: No cuffless BP calibration study.

inference_inputs: one available cardiac modality, e.g. PPG
deployment.notes: Delay aligner is learned during pretraining; BP head still needs separate validation.

leakage_audit.abp_bp_alignment: cross-modal delay alignment uses paired sensors, not BP target
leakage_audit.notes: No absolute BP claim should be inferred.

records.notes: 重点深审。

records.title: The role of dataset integrity, calibration and signal quality in neural network-based blood pressure estimation
records.model_method: MLP, ResNet and TCN are compared on datasets differing in synchronization; subject-wise splits and 3–9 initial reference measurements test calibration effects.
records.main_results: VitalDB consistently outperformed MIMIC-III; calibration gains diminished beyond three measurements; calibrated DBP reached numerical clinical limits while SBP remained difficult.

calibration.notes: Diminishing return beyond three initial measurements.

subject_split.notes: Abstract explicitly reports subject-wise splits to prevent leakage.

external_validation.notes: Cross-dataset comparison is not the same as training on one and untouched external testing on another.

deployment.notes: Requires initial cuff/reference measurements; emphasizes synchronized data and SQA.

leakage_audit.abp_bp_alignment: dataset-level synchronization is studied, not oracle per-window alignment
leakage_audit.abp_bp_quality_filtering: signal-quality curation used; exact target dependence needs methods audit
leakage_audit.notes: A methodological audit paper; still requires checking how curated test windows were selected.

records.notes: 重点深审。

records.title: Change Point–Aware Evaluation and Re-Calibration of PPG-Based Blood Pressure Estimation
records.model_method: Detects distributional change points in BP trajectories, evaluates models around fluctuations, and triggers targeted recalibration.
records.main_results: Shows substantial model degradation near BP change points; periodic calibration is insufficient, while change-point-triggered recalibration improves robustness (exact values pending table extraction).

calibration.notes: Deployment validity depends on whether trigger detection uses predicted BP/PPG only or true reference BP.

external_validation.notes: No independent clinical external validation confirmed.

deployment.judgment: 触发机制需改造成无参考 BP
deployment.notes: If true BP change points trigger recalibration, the reported protocol is not autonomous.

leakage_audit.abp_bp_windowing: YES for evaluation periods around true BP change points
leakage_audit.target_dependent_calibration: potentially YES — trigger is defined from BP trajectories
leakage_audit.notes: Valuable evaluation framework; its deployment claim must separate oracle change points from detectable real-world triggers.

records.notes: 重点深审。

records.title: Domain-independent PPG signal quality assessment framework via representation learning
records.model_method: Fine-tunes a pretrained PPG Transformer with triplet loss; quality is embedding distance to high-quality reference embeddings.
records.main_results: Approximate F1: 90% finger, 95% wrist with generalized references, 70% neck.

calibration.notes: No BP calibration; reference embeddings define signal-quality score.

subject_split.notes: Exact subject partition details need table-level audit.

deployment.judgment: 适合作为 BP 模型前置 SQA
deployment.notes: Real-time compatible; no BP target needed.

leakage_audit.abp_bp_quality_filtering: PPG morphology/expert quality labels, not BP values
leakage_audit.notes: If used in BP studies, freeze SQA before test evaluation and avoid tuning thresholds on test BP error.

records.notes: 重点深审。

records.title: Large-scale bilateral cardiovascular monitoring via wearable rings
records.model_method: Twelve backbones benchmark bilateral and averaged ring-PPG prediction across cardiovascular/demographic targets.
records.main_results: 97,559 valid samples from 1,810 participants; bilateral SBP/DBP MAE 12.36/8.21 mmHg, only modestly better than cohort-mean baselines 13.81/9.27.

calibration.notes: Population benchmark.

subject_split.notes: Do not assume session-level split is safe.

deployment.judgment: HR 价值较强，绝对 BP 价值有限
deployment.notes: Two-ring requirement is itself a deployment cost.

leakage_audit.notes: Transparent weak BP result is more credible than near-zero MAE under unsafe splits.

records.notes: 重点深审。

records.title: Evaluation of Alysis-001 cuffless blood pressure estimation algorithm against the European Society of Hypertension awake/asleep test criteria in hypertensive patients
records.model_method: Biomechanical Moens–Korteweg-based multiparametric algorithm estimates velocity, volume and arterial elasticity; motion/posture correction and signal-quality rejection are applied.
records.main_results: 92 enrolled, 78 analyzed; passed all ESH awake/asleep criteria under both extraction strategies; ICC >0.70, non-dipper sensitivity 0.93, specificity 0.75, accuracy 0.82.

calibration.notes: Uses age, height and weight; no initial or periodic cuff calibration.

subject_split.notes: Evaluation cohort has no overlap with independent development datasets.

external_validation.notes: Reference ABPM every 30 min; ESH awake/asleep primary test, not the entire cuffless-device validation suite.

deployment.notes: Automatically rejects high-intensity activity; does not require cuff calibration.

leakage_audit.abp_bp_alignment: 30-min aggregation used for comparison, not to generate individual estimates
leakage_audit.abp_bp_windowing: wearable uses fixed 10 s cycles; reference ABPM does not select beats
leakage_audit.abp_bp_quality_filtering: internal sensor SQA/IMU rejection, not reference-BP filtering
leakage_audit.window_leakage: not applicable to independent prospective cohort
leakage_audit.notes: Reference ABPM is used for validation, not fed into Alysis estimates.

records.notes: 重点深审；通过 awake/asleep primary test does not equal completing every ESH test.

records.title: A Multi-posture Asymmetry-aware Intelligent Bilateral Observation Dataset for Cardiovascular Monitoring
records.model_method: Dataset descriptor: synchronized bilateral ring PPG across three standardized postures with SBP/DBP/HR and demographic labels.
records.main_results: 1,810 participants and 7,478 sessions; designed for bilateral and posture-dependent cardiovascular benchmarking.

calibration.notes: Reference BP labels are provided; downstream users must define calibration protocol.

subject_split.notes: Dataset users must split by participant ID; random session/window split is unsafe.

external_validation.notes: Dataset resource, not an externally validated estimator.

deployment.notes: Suitable for left→right and posture-shift tests.

leakage_audit.risk_level: low at dataset construction / high if mis-split
leakage_audit.abp_bp_alignment: reference labels synchronized at session level
leakage_audit.abp_bp_quality_filtering: dataset QC present; no current-BP inverse scaling found
leakage_audit.notes: Dataset does not guarantee safe downstream splitting by itself.

records.notes: 重点深审。

records.title: HealthRing: Physiology Dataset for Health Sensing on Rings
records.model_method: Three synchronized cohorts: controlled stimuli, semi-free-living activities and treadmill running; RingTool provides signal-processing and DL baselines.
records.main_results: 54 adults; controlled+daily benchmarks: SBP/DBP MAE 12.98/7.64 mmHg, HR 5.33 bpm, RR 2.98 breaths/min, SpO2 1.72%.

calibration.notes: Dataset paper does not establish a product calibration protocol.

subject_split.notes: Downstream users must preserve subject separation.

external_validation.notes: Motion cohort tests transfer, but BP benchmark is mainly controlled/daily.

deployment.judgment: 真实 wearable 数据价值高，BP 精度有限
deployment.notes: Supports rejection/robustness research under arm swing.

leakage_audit.abp_bp_alignment: synchronized labels are dataset ground truth
leakage_audit.abp_bp_quality_filtering: quality controls present; target dependence not established
leakage_audit.notes: Benchmark MAE is not a consumer-device validation.

records.notes: 重点深审。

records.title: Causal Decomposition of PPG Signals for Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation
records.model_method: EEMD decomposes PPG into IMFs; counterfactual exclusion and structural causal modeling select BP-relevant components; CNN/GBRT/PAT baselines are compared.
records.main_results: IMF4–6 showed strongest causal association; CNN using IMF4+5 achieved SBP/DBP MAE 5.55/3.45 mmHg, improving 26.39%/17.86% over original PPG.

calibration.notes: Abstract does not describe a deployment calibration protocol.

external_validation.notes: No external cohort confirmed from abstract.

deployment.judgment: 算法上可 PPG-only，证据不足
deployment.notes: Causal component selection is learned offline; real-time EEMD cost and cross-dataset stability remain open.

leakage_audit.notes: Causal language does not substitute for subject-disjoint and external validation.

records.notes: 重点深审。

records.title: A Revised Point-to-Point Calibration Approach with Adaptive Errors Correction to Weaken Initial Sensitivity of Cuff-Less Blood Pressure Estimation
records.model_method: Compares original one-point PTP calibration with mean PTP (mPTP) and penalty-factor adaptive PTP (fPTP) correction across exercise intensities.
records.main_results: mPTP and fPTP reduce sensitivity to a single initial calm-state sample and improve consistency relative to oPTP; exact metrics retained in source paper.

calibration.points: multiple calm-state points for mean; adaptive correction thereafter
calibration.notes: Older calibration baseline included because it was explicitly referenced in prior planning.

deployment.notes: Must ensure fPTP updates do not use contemporaneous reference BP unavailable in deployment.

leakage_audit.abp_bp_alignment: ECG–PPG timing is an input feature
leakage_audit.target_dependent_calibration: historical BP definitely used; real-time correction path requires audit

records.notes: 补录此前明确提到的校准基线。
